_about: OoT3D product facts (owner decision 2026-11-08, BRANDING answer 1): the installed game executable takes the product name. The build output stays TriAevum.exe (runtime/TriAevum.exe in the package); Forge's install step renames it (forge-catalog platform.rs WINDOWS_PRODUCT_EXECUTABLE, release_platform.py). Guard words: Echoes of Time, Ocarina of Time 3D. Linux (owner decision 2026-11-08, Linux names): linux_executable is the installed game binary name; the Linux package keeps the build output TriAevum at its root and Forge renames it at install (forge-catalog platform.rs LINUX_PRODUCT_EXECUTABLE). pipeline_cache_namespace names the title's renderer pipeline cache files; OoT3D keeps the empty namespace, the original file names (nri_pipeline_cache.bin).
